newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine weekly official crop progress.
newsitem.headline: Argentine weekly official crop progress.

text.p: Argentine farmers had sown 99.9 percent of an intended total 6.8 million hectares with wheat by September 13, the Agriculture Secretariat said Thursday in its weekly crop report.

Sunflower sowing continued in the west of Entre Rios province and in northern Santa Fe. Recent rains allowed sowing to start again in Chaco, but in Santiago del Estero planting was still paralayzed due to dryness. Total intended sowing of 2.984 million hectares is 12.5 percent below last season's sown area. Early maize planting continued in Buenos Aires and Santa Fe. Total maize area should grow 11.1 percent from last season.
